note: Placeholder authored text (owner review pending). The apprentice's mother. Variants read the behaviour ledger as facts: grounded, kills, protests, resurrections, deaths, victim (a name), child (a name).

lines: I have stopped counting. {victim} is dead again, and you are standing there with that face.
I am not angry. I am past angry. I am into something the priests do not have a word for. Put them back.
You have killed your friend? Again? Well. You are not going anywhere until you put them back.
And do not tell me who started it. I was at the window.
I heard you the first time. A fair duel. Everybody agreed. Very proper.
{victim} is still dead, and you are still not leaving this village until that changes.
{child}. Come here. No, here. Look at me.
{victim} is lying in the square with the chickens walking round them, and you are off somewhere with your staff. You are not going anywhere until you put them back.
There. Was that so hard? Now the pair of you go and be useful, and if I see another body in my square I will put you both in it.
You died. I want you to know that I knew. A mother knows. I was fetching water and the bucket went cold.
Whatever you do out there, you come back. That is the only rule I have ever given you.
Where were you? No, do not tell me. While you were off wherever you were, a stranger in a black cloak walked into the square and killed {mentor}. Just like that. Nobody could do a thing.
He said he would be back when you were strong enough to be worth the trouble. I would take that as a reason to be somewhere else, but you never listened to me either.
You came to us after it all happened. {mentor} is dead: killed in the square by a stranger who walked in as if the road was his, and walked out again the same way.

lines.text: There was an apprentice here before you. {previous}. Do not go the way they went; I have buried enough.

lines: Learn what you can from whoever is left. And eat something.
Have you eaten? You have not eaten. Wizards forget to eat, that is how they get thin and strange.
If you are going to the warehouse, tell them their rats are in my pantry now.

choices.text: It was a duel. They agreed to it.
lines: I don't care who started it. Resurrect them.

choices.text: And if I just walk off?
lines: Then you will find that every road out of this village has me standing in it. I raised you. I know how fast you walk.
Good. Stand next to them and do whatever it is you do. I will be watching from the window, so do it properly.
Old. Busy. Proud, mostly, though I would not say it to your face. Go on, you have a village to see to.
Go on then. Come back for supper.
